title: A water point that did not pass its SDWS 3 commissioning test is not creditable

decision.text: A water point that did not pass SDWS 3 is not creditable, is not part of the carbon portfolio, and is excluded from survey frames.

homes: sanitap-sampler: data/sdws3_rule.json (embedded as Core.SDWS3_RULE in app.js)

form.name: Clean Water || Water Quality Testing_ SDWS 3__ Result

selection: Per water point, only its latest final result counts, ordered by result date (WS7.10), then by submission time. A later passing retest restores the point.

fail_if.label: fluoride
fail_if.note: 1.5 mg/L is the kit maximum, so a reading of 1.5 means over-range, not a pass

blank: A parameter left blank does not fail the result (all four are required on the form, so a final response carries them).
no_result: A water point with no final SDWS 3 result is not touched by this rule and keeps its current treatment.

exceptions.reason: The turbidity of 11 NTU is a data-entry slip: the team's kit cannot read turbidity that precisely. Turbidity is ignored for this response only.
